REM REQ: LANG-791 LANG-792 LANG-793 LANG-794
@echo off
setlocal enabledelayedexpansion
:: Double-colon comment
set NAME=world
set /a COUNT=3

:loop
if %COUNT% leq 0 goto done
echo Hello, %NAME%! Count: !COUNT! in %~dp0
set /a COUNT-=1
goto loop

:done
for %%f in (*.txt) do (
    echo %%f
)
if exist "%1" call :helper %1 & rem trailing remark
remove-me.exe > nul 2>&1
exit /b 0
